source.author: verg
source.text: Rex erat Aeneas nobis, quo iustior alter, nec pietate fuit, nec bello maior et armis.
source.text_original: 'Rex erat Aeneas nobis, quo iustior alter, / nec pietate fuit, nec bello maior et armis.
source.text_english: Aeneas was a king to us, than whom no one was more just, nor was there ever anyone greater in dutifulness, nor in war and arms.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: aput Maronem rex ille, quo iustior alter nec pietate fuit nec bello maior et armis, quae nobis documenta iustitiae protulit?
reuse.text_original: aput Maronem rex ille, quo iustior alter nec pietate fuit nec bello maior et armis, quae nobis documenta iustitiae protulit?
reuse.text_english: In Virgil, what examples of justice did that king provide for us, he who was not surpassed by any other in righteousness, nor greater in piety, nor in war and arms?
